# Mattia Rigotti

> {{ p.bio }}

## Career

- 2020–present: Senior Research Scientist, IBM Research – Zurich, Switzerland.
  - Technical lead for algorithmic innovation in IBM's neural operators for computational fluid dynamics effort (since 2024); GIST (NeurIPS 2026).
  - Initiated IBM's visual prompting research and served as its technical lead; shipped as VP Lab in IBM Maximo Visual Inspection (generally available 2025).
  - LLM alignment and reasoning: Alignment via Optimal Transport (NeurIPS 2024), Cognitive Tools (NeurIPS 2025).
  - Principal Investigator for IBM Research on EU Horizon grants (2020–present).
  - Supervises PhD students (TU Wien, ETH Zurich, EPFL) and master's interns.
- 2014–2020: Research Staff Member, IBM T.J. Watson Research Center, Yorktown Heights, New York.
  - Led the challenge team on neural network training under hardware and biological constraints.
  - Lead developer of the approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval pipeline for IBM MolFormer.
  - 1st place, CVPR 2020 VizWiz Grand Challenge (image captioning for blind users).
- 2013–2014: Associate Research Fellow, Columbia University.
- 2010–2013: Postdoctoral Fellow, Center for Neural Science, New York University.
